titles.title: Skunk Cabbage

description: Vertical canvas with large brown and reddish bean shape in the lower center that has a twisting stem rising out and up. From behind this is a light blue-green leaf-like shape that points upwards, the tip of which touches the top of the canvas.  The background is a swirling blending combination of green and yellow on the left, and orange, green, rust and black on the right.  In the lower left corner is a grey leaf-like extension on black.
